value_domain: Payment group
values: EMP: Employer payment (incentive or wage subsidy paid to the employer)
APP: Australian Apprentice payment (personal benefit paid to the apprentice)
value_source: DEWR, Australian Apprenticeship Service Delivery Operating Guidelines (Appendix E, 2024-2026 Deed RFT)
rationale: PAYMENTGROUP is the copy of the payment group carried on the payments_2023 record itself, joining to PAYMENTGROUPCODE on code_payment_type. The payment group is the higher of the two tiers in code_payment_type, with several payment types under each group. The payments_2023 record carries both GSTAMOUNT and PAYGTAXAMOUNT: GST applies to payments made to a business, PAYG withholding to taxable payments made to an individual, and the departmental guidelines confirm that AATSP and NEASP are taxable apprentice payments while the Hiring Incentive and Priority Wage Subsidy go to employers. Splitting payment types by recipient is therefore the most likely grouping. A grouping by programme (Incentives Program before 1 July 2022, Incentives System after, and Trade Support Loans separately) is a plausible alternative, and neither grouping is published. The letter codes shown are inferred.
evidence_quote: AATSP, and/or NEASP for taxation purposes

This corrects an earlier reading of the field as an ANZSIC industry code, which rested only on the _INDUSTRY suffix; ANZSIC has no Food, Forestry, Primary or Public Sector category, and public sector is an institutional-sector concept rather than an industry at all.
